purpose: Preserve reported current results, independently check arithmetic, and distinguish observed local artifacts from verified latest-run provenance.

reported_result_attribution.source: User confirmation supplied for this documentation audit
reported_result_attribution.limitation: Matching local metrics are verified below; their observed caches use schema 2 and cannot establish a schema 4 rerun. No result is relabeled on the basis of this evidence gap.

audited_current_implementation.scope: Documentation audit code baseline, not an experiment execution commit.
audited_current_implementation.configuration_scope: Current code defaults; runtime CLI overrides must be preserved separately.

statistics.mean: statistics.mean over five final test metrics
statistics.accuracy_display: mean and std multiplied by 100; mean is a percentage, std is in percentage points; two decimal places
statistics.mae_display: raw label scale, no percentage conversion; four decimal places
